description: NFL player season totals from nflverse, 1999–current: passing, rushing, receiving, defense, kicking and returns, with EPA, CPOE, target share and fantasy points. Look up by player name or nflverse/GSIS id. Example: Joe Burrow 2024 → 4,918 passing yards, 43 TD. Returns found:false when no player matches.

player.description: Player name ("Lamar Jackson", partial names match) or nflverse/GSIS player id ("00-0034796").

season.description: NFL season year (1999–current). The 2024 season includes its January–February 2025 playoff games. Defaults to the current season.

season_type.description: REG (regular season, default), POST (playoffs) or REGPOST (combined).

name: nfl_player_season_stats
title: Nfl Player Season Stats
